title: Registrierung erzeugt eine eigene Organisation
description: As a new user, I want to register and create my own organisation, so that my team and I can start managing prompts.

acceptance_criteria.given: no account exists for the given e-mail address
acceptance_criteria.when: the user registers with e-mail and password
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 201, creates a new organisation and assigns the role ORG_ADMIN to the user
and: the access token contains the id of the newly created organisation
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-002-registration.feature: Registration creates an organisation and makes the user its admin

acceptance_criteria.given: an account already exists for the given e-mail address
acceptance_criteria.when: the user tries to register again
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 409 and no organisation is created
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-002-registration.feature: Registration with an existing e-mail is rejected

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing organisation with developers already exists
acceptance_criteria.when: a new user registers and tries to select that organisation
acceptance_criteria.then: the API ignores the attempted organisation selection
and: the new user is a member of a separate new organisation only
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-002-registration.feature: Registration cannot join an existing organisation
